Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production 429 spike — immediate help needed

Irene —

We started seeing a massive increase in 429 responses from your API around 07:45 PDT. Our ingestion pipeline is timing out, and retries have amplified the issue — we're getting consistent 5xx follow-ups. This started right after we flipped to the new org->project tiering mapping in our onboarding flow; our engineers suspect a mis-assigned project tier making many requests hit a lower quota.

Attached are a small sample of logs and one of our error traces (arbor_429-sample-logs.txt). Can you confirm whether this is a config/tiering change on Redwood's side? We need a mitigation plan and ETA — this is impacting customer-facing flows.

Thanks,
Asha

Subject: Re: Fwd: Production 429 spike — immediate help needed

Irene / team — quick summary from infra: we had a deployment at 07:30 that intended to migrate legacy project labels into the new tiering table. The migration included a small transform that maps org-level tiers down to project-level aliases. It looks like a subset of projects got the wrong alias (off-by-one on the split logic) which assigned them to the substandard quota. That produced 429s once traffic surfaced, and ArborCloud's client-side retry logic caused a retry storm that pushed upstream into some of our edge pools causing cascading 5xx timeouts.

Immediate mitigation steps taken (already in progress):
- Rolled back the tiering migration at 08:34 (partial rollback, full rollback started).
- Temporarily increased per-project token quota for affected projects (manual override) — this will hold for 2 hours.
- Enabled stricter ingress rate limiting per-IP at the edge to dampen retry amplification.

Remaining asks for CS/AE: please request that ArborCloud throttle / apply exponential backoff in the next 30 min; we've prepared a tactical MAP (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) with steps and timelines.

I'll keep this thread updated as we verify whether any projects remain mis-assigned.

-ben

Asha — quick status update and next steps: 

- Root cause: mis-applied project->tier alias during a migration (off-by-one split). That assigned ~18 projects to a lower quota bucket.
- Immediate mitigations done: full rollback completed at 09:10 PDT, manual per-project quota overrides applied, and edge-level ingress throttles enabled to limit retry amplification.
- Customer action: please enable exponential backoff (10s base) and hold aggressive retries for 1 hour while we monitor. If you can't change client behavior, we can extend overrides for another 2 hours.
- Long-term fix: Marcus will deploy a hotfix and add unit/regression tests for that mapping transform (ETA ~6 hours). Neha will run a sweep for any other incomplete label migrations.

We've attached the MAP with precise steps and timings. We're treating this as an exec-level incident until ArborCloud confirms full traffic stabilization. I will loop in our Head of Sales if we need any credit/contract remediation.

Please reply with the affected project IDs and a thumbs up on backoff when ready.
